ABSTRACT OF THE DISCLOSURE
Provided is a male penis part magnetic resonance imaging integrated coil having an erection assisting function. The male penis part magnetic resonance imaging integrated coil mainly includes a cover body, a negative pressure suction erection assisting apparatus, a programmable erection degree control system, and a multi-channel magnetic resonance imaging coil, and is connected to a full-automatic magnetic resonance contrast agent injection system through a pipeline. The integrated coil is similar to a penis in shape and can be used for penis magnetic resonance imaging to obtain a high-quality image; the negative pressure suction erection assisting apparatus can enable a patient having erectile dysfunction to reach a penile erection state without injection of an erection assisting drug, and the quality of the image is improved. By adjusting blood flow volume and blood flow speed of a penile blood vessel through the erection degree control system, penis cavernous body angiography can be performed to achieve non-invasive diagnosis of the patient having erectile dysfunction, and cavernosography is expected to be replaced. the blood flow volume and blood flow speed of a penile blood vessel are adjusted by means of the erection degree control system, penis cavernous body angiography can be performed, non-invasive diagnosis of the patient having erectile dysfunction is achieved, and cavernosography is expected to be replaced. When non-invasive angiography is poor, a contrast agent is injected by means of the full-automatic magnetic resonance contrast agent injection system, so that angiography can be optimized. Stimulating ejaculation and evaluating the ejaculation function of the patient can provide a more comprehensive diagnosis and treatment value for the patient.
